exercises.question: Which sentence gives advice rather than a strict obligation?
options: Deberías hablar con ella porque quizá no conoce el problema. [You should speak to her because she may not know the problem.]
Tienes que entregar el formulario hoy, antes de las cinco. [You have to hand in the form today, before five.]
Debes entregar el formulario antes de salir de la oficina. [You must hand in the form before leaving the office.]

exercises.sentence: Deberías __ con tu profesor antes de decidir.
exercises.english: You should speak to your teacher before deciding.
You should take a precaution because the road is dangerous.

sentences: Primero deberías leer las instrucciones. [First you should read the instructions.]
Después tienes que comprobar los datos. [Then you have to check the data.]
Finalmente, toma una decisión. [Finally, make a decision.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: No sé qué hacer con este problema.

options: Deberías hablar con un amigo de confianza. [You should talk to a friend you trust.]
Hablarás con un amigo de confianza. [You will talk to a friend you trust.]
Hablabas con un amigo de confianza. [You were talking to a friend you trust.]

exercises.question: In «Tienes que revisar los datos», what is the meaning? [¿Qué significa «Tienes que revisar los datos»?]
options: You have to check the data. [Tienes que comprobar los datos.]
You should check the data. [Deberías comprobar los datos.]
You may check the data. [Puedes comprobar los datos.]

exercises.sentence: Tienes que __ los datos antes de decidir.
exercises.english: You have to review the data before deciding.
Be careful because the road may be dangerous.

exercises.sentence: Deberías hablar con ella antes de tomar una decisión.
options: You should speak to her before making a decision.
You have to speak to her after making a decision.
You spoke to her before making a decision.

exercises.sentence: Tienes que revisar los datos antes de tomar una decisión.
exercises.english: You have to review the data before making a decision.

options: Tienes que revisar el contrato porque puede haber un problema. [You have to check the contract because there may be a problem.]
Revisabas el contrato porque podía haber un problema. [You were checking the contract because there could be a problem.]
Revisaste el contrato porque podía haber un problema. [You checked the contract because there could be a problem.]

exercises.question: Which is the most direct instruction?
options: Toma una precaución antes de salir. [Take a precaution before leaving.]
Deberías tomar una precaución antes de salir. [You should take a precaution before leaving.]
Sería mejor tomar una precaución antes de salir. [It would be better to take a precaution before leaving.]

exercises.sentence: No __ tan rápido, aunque tengas prisa.
exercises.english: Do not go so fast, even if you are in a hurry.

template.prompt: Give someone advice with deber and explain why.
template.answer: Deberías descansar porque has trabajado mucho.

template.prompt: Give a stronger obligation with tener que.
template.answer: Tienes que terminar el informe antes de mañana.

template.prompt: Give a direct imperative and a reason.
template.answer: Ten cuidado porque el camino puede ser peligroso.

template.prompt: Give one precaution the person should take.
template.answer: Deberías llevar agua porque no hay tiendas cerca.
